title: What's New: Environment-Level Access Controls for Delegated Administrators (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to environment access control feature
Demo setup: tenant admin center and production environments
Partner access setting and modification interface
Understanding access types: GDAP and application-level access
Configuring selected partners for environment access
Reverting settings and disabling partner access entirely
Impact on authentication and relationship with tenant-level access
Limitations and administrative access control restrictions

features.name: Partner access control by environment
features.description: A new feature allowing internal administrators to control which partner tenants can access and administer specific environments. Can be set to all partners, selected partners, or off.
caveats: Requires proper tenant-level access consents and GDAP relationships to already be set up
Limited to restricting access for up to 10 Entra tenants per environment
Only available for internal administrators to configure
Affects both login access and admin center visibility

features.name: All partners access mode
features.description: The default partner access setting that grants access to all external partner tenants with GDAP relationships or application-level access.

features.name: Selected partners access mode
features.description: An access control mode that allows internal administrators to explicitly choose which partner tenants can access a specific environment, using a list of available foreign tenants.
caveats: Requires GDAP relationships or application-level access to already exist
Maximum of 10 Entra tenants can be allowed per environment

features.name: Partner access disabled mode
features.description: A setting that disables partner access entirely, restricting environment access and administration to internal administrators only.

features.name: Environment details page partner access setting
features.description: A new setting on the environment details page in the tenant admin center that controls partner access levels with a modify interface.
